description: Use this when an agent needs US airport delays, ground stops, or closures. kind="intuitive" (default; optional airport, default SFO): briefing; kind="stats": delay history; kind="pro": multi-airport/route compare; kind="signals": ground stop/GDP/weather flags + Data BitScore. Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.
